data.short_description: Dope Coffee, which opened in Azalea Fresh Market in Downtown Atlanta last year, recently closed its location at Azalea. Owner Mike Loyd Jr. announced the closure in May, sharing plans to relocate to a space allowing upgraded customer service.

data.status: in active buildout
data.short_description: A flagship Dope Coffee location and roastery is in active buildout in Stonecrest. It will function as both a sit-down cafe and manufacturing facility, featuring roasting/packaging spaces, a walk-up bar, specialty coffee on tap, and patio seating.

data.status: reopened
data.short_description: The Nutella Café in Chicago reopened on July 17 after closing in March 2026 for a major renovation. The refreshed space features a swirling bronze mesh ceiling, updated decor, and an expanded menu including Nutella tiramisu cups, milkshakes, and mocha frappes.

data.status: ending its run
data.short_description: Victory Sandwich Bar will be ending its run in Decatur as ownership group Vic Brands pivots the space to a new concept. The Inman Park Victory Sandwich Bar location will continue to operate.

data.status: will unveil
data.short_description: Vic Brands will unveil Besto at 340 Church St. at the end of July, replacing Victory Sandwich Bar. Besto will serve as an American-Italian restaurant and bar with a counter-service lunch menu of Italian sandwiches and a full-service dinner menu.
